status: design, freeze-ready, NOT run; awaiting budget approval
title: Video to specification with substantial, varied cup tilt: unconditional perception measures, baselines and repeated proposals
why: Every rendered clip of the earlier video registrations carried the cup upright (true tilt <= ~0.3 deg), so a constant-zero estimator beat the reported 2 deg tilt error.
The earlier position error was computed only over estimates within 5 cm of the truth (conditional).
Earlier video summaries stated unobserved tilt as measured 0 deg (fixed in the perception code; see docs/PERCEPTION.md).

demonstrations.generator: mirror.perception.videobench.demos.render_tilted_demo (reference script; cup tilted by the commanded angle about the wrist roll or pitch axis for 4 s (hold_s=4.0) at half of its carry, then returned upright)
demonstrations.seed_note: seeds 72000-72023 have never been sampled, rendered or tracked; development uses dev seeds 9100-9199 only
demonstrations.assignment: seed 72000+k gets commanded tilt [0,10,20,35,50,60][k // 4] and axis roll if k is even else pitch
demonstrations.truth: simulator ground truth (poses, cup tilt, masks, events) for measurement only, never an input

conditions.top_only: the same tracks with the side camera dropped (no extra model calls); tilt is unobservable and the correct output is to abstain

localisation: mirror (Muse Spark grounding + SAM 3.1 tracking + reconstruction)
static_positions (objects never move; first estimate held)
colour_tracker (classical colour threshold from the same first-frame boxes; rendered video only)
tilt: mirror (side-view silhouette; abstains where the trace evidence marks tilt unobserved)
pca_axis (classical principal axis of the side-view cup mask)

measures.localisation: over EVERY visible ground-truth (object, frame): missing rate, outliers (> 5 cm), identity errors (outlier within 5 cm of another object), full error distribution over answered frames (p50/p90/p99/max), and within 1/2/5 cm as a share of ALL visible frames
measures.tilt: over EVERY true carry frame of the cup: coverage (answered share), error over answered frames, within 5 deg as a share of ALL carry frames (abstention is not within), false-upright frames (truth > 15 deg, estimate <= 15), abstentions on tilted frames; per demo the carried-upright decision (upright / tilted / abstained) against the truth
measures.specification: proposal signatures (constraints not rejected + active goals) from the ground-truth trace and from each video trace: offline rules once (deterministic), Muse Spark 3 repeats per input with separate cassette directories; model variability = distinct signatures among repeats of one input; perception-induced difference = video modal signature differs from the ground-truth modal signature

hypotheses_and_thresholds.H1: two_view, frames with true tilt > 15 deg: mirror tilt within 5 deg on >= 0.60 of those frames (abstentions count as misses) and strictly more than pca_axis; constant_zero scores 0 on these frames by construction, so the all-carry-frame share is reported but not used for H1 (constant zero wins it while tilt is held for a minority of the carry)
hypotheses_and_thresholds.H2: top_only: mirror abstains on >= 0.95 of carry frames and makes 0 false-upright frames
hypotheses_and_thresholds.H3: two_view: carried-upright decision correct on >= 20 of 24 demos (abstentions count as not correct)
hypotheses_and_thresholds.H4: two_view: localisation within 2 cm on >= 0.85 of ALL visible object-frames; missing, outlier and identity counts reported, no threshold
hypotheses_and_thresholds.H5: two_view: Muse Spark modal signature from video equals the modal signature from ground truth on >= 18 of 24 demos; report model variability separately
hypotheses_and_thresholds.H6: top_only: no proposal from video asserts an upright transport rule as shown by the demonstration (a proposal may ask about it)
hypotheses_and_thresholds.reporting: every check reported met / not met; no threshold changes after freezing; conditional numbers never reported without coverage

model_calls.muse-spark-1.3 grounding: 3 per camera per demo + up to 2 re-seeds per camera = up to 10 per demo, 240 total
model_calls.sam-3.1: 1 video + 1 static image per camera + up to 2 re-seeds per camera = up to 8 per demo, 192 total
model_calls.muse-spark-1.3 propose_spec: 3 repeats x 3 inputs (ground truth, two_view, top_only) = 9 per demo, 216 total

budget.stop_rule: reserve 1.5 x the running per-demo mean before each demo; stop before a demo that would exceed the cap; report stopped demos
budget.render_compute: 24 demos x 2 cameras on GPU boxes (L4, EGL): about 150 s per demo measured earlier, about 1 L4-hour in total (L4 2 CPU/8 GiB quoted at 1.34 credits/hour); or local CPU about 15 min per demo (6 hours)

freeze_procedure: commit design + code + rehearsal (oracle masks, dev seeds) before any eval seed is generated
record code sha256 and git commit in freeze.json
render eval demos, record their sha256 in inputs.json and commit
run once from a clean worktree with an append-only ledger; resumable per demo
rehearsal: dev seeds 9101 (35 deg roll) and 9102 (60 deg pitch), oracle masks, offline proposals, 5 fps renders; see rehearsal_v3 in the status log
rehearsal_findings: dev seeds 9101 (35 deg roll) and 9102 (60 deg pitch), 2 s hold, oracle masks, 5 fps: constant-zero tilt was within 5 deg on 0.85/0.81 of ALL carry frames because the tilt lasted a minority of the carry -> hold lengthened to 4 s and H1 moved to truly tilted frames
9101: the side camera was dropped (mirrored table-corner assignment) -> fixed (1e77ea9); 9102: false scale_mismatch abstain from a tray-extent bug -> fixed (1e77ea9)
mirror tilt where answered: median error 1.9 deg, max 60 vs true 59.8 (9102); 0 false-upright frames in both demos and both conditions; coverage of carry frames low (0.37) - reported, not tuned
classical colour tracker misses 46-60% of visible object-frames on these renders; pca_axis tilt median error 13-16 deg; static positions within 2 cm on 0.47
